gotchas.text: Engine build: the gist builds vLLM 0.27.1 from source against CUDA 13.2 and does not publish the build. These rows ran the official release image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1-aarch64, repo digest sha256:1c8e60a0841b333c700488cb029d3664807249da0c071e862191b00fe34b228c, which is the same v0.27.1 tag (6e448d0ea) built against CUDA 13.0 with torch arch list up to sm_120. The gist environment (CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_121a, FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1a) was set as written.

max-num-seqs is 8, so serve-short-c16 queues half of its 16 streams. With 3 speculative tokens vLLM also caps max_num_scheduled_tokens at 2048 and warns that this may be suboptimal, so long prompts prefill in 2,048-token chunks.

KV cache dtype is not set (auto), but unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 carries a static per-tensor 8-bit float kv_cache_scheme, and FlashInfer resolved kv_cache_dtype float8_e4m3fn. This boot allocated 72.79 GiB of KV cache, 2,054,681 tokens, 7.84x concurrency at 262144; the gist reports 2,032,714 tokens for the same settings. The attention block size is 1,600 tokens and the mamba prefix cache runs in align mode.

Speculative decoding with FlashInfer attention cannot use full CUDA graphs: vLLM logs that FULL_AND_PIECEWISE is not supported with spec-decode for this backend and falls back to cudagraph_mode PIECEWISE.

The target is not pinned by the gist, which loads a local path. The snapshot served was unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 main f0b7c9e7 (2026-09-08). The MTP drafter is the head bundled in the same checkpoint (model_mtp.safetensors, one layer); vLLM shares the target embedding and lm_head with it.
vLLM reads generation_config.json from the target and overrides its own sampling defaults with temperature 1.0, top_k 20, top_p 0.95. Every request here sets temperature 0 and seed 42.

Speed rows force thinking off per request with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false. Eval rows use the served default, thinking on at full length; the gist sets no reasoning level on the server.

provenance.notes: Served with the single-node launch from the GitHub gist "Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 + MTP-3 on a single DGX Spark" by Mirrdhyn (https://gist.github.com/Mirrdhyn/d476d17723c9d68eac72f03ec9447f2b, revision ee1ffa6b of 2026-08-17). The gist builds vLLM 0.27.1 from source against CUDA 13.2; these rows ran the official vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1-aarch64 release image instead (repo digest sha256:1c8e60a0, vLLM 0.27.1 at 6e448d0ea, torch 2.13.0+cu130, FlashInfer 0.6.16.post3, transformers 5.15.0). Flags as in the gist: target unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 from a local snapshot (main f0b7c9e7), MTP speculative decoding with 3 tokens from the MTP head bundled in the same checkpoint, max-model-len 262144, max-num-seqs 8, gpu-memory-utilization 0.82, prefix caching on, 4 images and 0 videos per prompt, reasoning parser qwen3, tool parser qwen3_xml with auto tool choice, FlashInfer autotune on, tensor-parallel-size 1. Environment as in the gist: CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_121a, FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.1a, FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1, PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=1. Only the port (8888 instead of 8000) and the usage-stats opt-outs VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 and DO_NOT_TRACK=1 were added. vLLM chose the FlashInfer attention backend, an fp8_e4m3 KV cache from the checkpoint kv_cache_scheme and FlashInferCutlassNvFp4LinearKernel for the NVFP4 layers. The chat template comes from the target repository, so the served default is thinking on: the speed rows force thinking off per request with chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false, the eval rows use that served default. The server runs without an API key; the harness attached over HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8888 and sent a bearer header the server ignores.
